items.description: Map repository modules and artifact flow before planning implementation
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/repository_map.md` lists `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.opencode/tools/concept_evolve.ts`, `.opencode/tools/semantic_scholar.ts`, `.opencode/agents/*.md`, `results/literature/`, `results/swarm/`, and `results/verification/`, explains wrapper-to-Python-to-results data flow, and notes that no gravity simulator implementation exists yet.
items.notes: Mapped toolchain and artifact flow, ran ConceptEvolve kickoff, and wrote repository_map plus steering_notes; confirmed no simulator implementation existed before this pass.

items.description: Lock the core research problem from saved swarm and novelty context
items.acceptance_criteria: The researcher reads `results/swarm/hypotheses.json`, `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`, `results/swarm/director_brief.md`, `results/literature/novelty_guard.json`, and `results/literature/gap_frontier.md`; `results/problem_statement.md` defines H1 as the default, H2 as backup, limits scope to a deterministic Newtonian 2-body/3-body/small-N reference kernel, and lists explicit non-claims about new integrators, large-N engines, and UI novelty.
items.notes: Locked H1 as the default claim, H2 as backup, and bounded scope to a deterministic Newtonian 2-body/3-body/small-N reference kernel with explicit non-claims.

items.description: Extend the literature snapshot with targeted web and paper search
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` is extended in place rather than recreated from zero, adds at least 10 newly reviewed relevant entries across papers, code repositories, and production tools, and records targeted web or Semantic Scholar coverage for the REBOUND branch, the poliastro or Orekit branch, the educational two-body or PhET branch, and the cross-runtime determinism branch with no more than one broad query.
items.notes: Extended the existing literature snapshot with 13 targeted entries spanning papers, code repositories, teaching tools, and production tools; covered REBOUND, poliastro/Orekit, PhET/two-body teaching resources, and the cross-runtime determinism branch without generic task-string re-search.

items.description: Create and maintain the bibliography and prior-art differentiation log
items.acceptance_criteria: Repo-root `sources.bib` exists with BibTeX or BibLaTeX entries for every consulted source, including at least 10 relevant papers and any baseline software cited; `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` contains non-empty differentiation notes for `Data-constrained Solar Modeling with GX Simulator (2023)`, `Three-axis borehole gravity monitoring for CO2 storage using machine learning coupled to fluid flow simulator (2023)`, `Trajectories of Bright Stars and Shadows around Supermassive Black Holes as Tests of Gravity Theories (2023)`, and `Gravity-perfused airway-on-a-chip optimized for quantitative BSL-3 studies of SARS-CoV-2 infection: barrier permeability, cytokine production, immunohistochemistry, and viral load assays`.
items.notes: Created sources.bib with 17 paper/software/spec entries and filled the prior-art gap log with dated differentiation notes for every named watchlist paper, including the off-target false positives.

items.description: Delegate Phase 1 exploration and synthesize concept-tree leads
items.acceptance_criteria: A researcher exploration pass and a reviewer synthesis pass are completed; `results/concept_evolve/tree/` contains `index.json`, `walk_paths.json`, and at least 10 concept folders; `results/phase1_synthesis.md` names 3 promising concept paths, 3 rejected branches, and the recommended H1/H2/H3 selection.

items.description: Specify the baseline simulator architecture and module boundaries
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/baseline_architecture.md` defines the state representation, force model, integrator boundary, scenario file format, deterministic update order, unit or normalization conventions, and module boundaries for the physics core, diagnostics, scenario IO, and benchmark harness.

items.description: Build the audited minimal baseline kernel in one reference runtime
items.acceptance_criteria: A working baseline exists for 2-body, 3-body, and small-N direct-sum scenarios in one reference runtime, and the code path cleanly separates force accumulation, integration stepping, invariant logging, and scenario execution without claiming Barnes-Hut, high-performance, or general-purpose N-body novelty.

items.description: Define the benchmark pack and metric formulas before comparative testing
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/benchmark_spec.md` enumerates analytic two-body controls for circular orbit, ellipse, period, escape velocity, and orbital elements; defines energy, angular momentum, and center-of-mass drift metrics; and assigns explicit formulas, pass or fail thresholds, and reporting units for every metric.

items.description: Freeze trusted baseline comparators derived from the literature review
items.acceptance_criteria: The comparison plan names REBOUND or an equivalent trusted direct-sum reference plus at least 2 lightweight or educational baselines discovered in Phase 1, and freezes matched initial conditions, timestep policies, output variables, and reporting tables before experiments begin.

items.description: Delegate a baseline and metrics audit before advancing to research features
items.acceptance_criteria: A researcher pass proposes the architecture and metric pack, a reviewer audit is completed, and `results/verification/baseline_design_review.md` records at least 5 concrete risks or missing controls plus a disposition for each item.

items.description: Revisit the concept tree to choose the narrowest defensible research wedge
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/concept_evolve/tree/` is revisited with at least 3 walk paths tied to determinism, close encounters, and unit safety, and `results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.json` or `results/phase3_concept_synthesis.md` records at least 1 promoted branch and 1 held or retired branch with rationale.

items.description: Implement core audited features that differentiate the simulator from a toy demo
items.acceptance_criteria: The research prototype exposes invariant tracking, timestep-halving convergence checks, reproducibility hooks, and scenario-level benchmark metadata as first-class outputs, and each feature is explicitly mapped back to one claim in `results/problem_statement.md`.

items.description: Run explicit novelty checks against named watchlist papers and true near-neighbors
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/verification/novelty_report.md` contains side-by-side comparison tables against `Data-constrained Solar Modeling with GX Simulator (2023)`, `Three-axis borehole gravity monitoring for CO2 storage using machine learning coupled to fluid flow simulator (2023)`, `Trajectories of Bright Stars and Shadows around Supermassive Black Holes as Tests of Gravity Theories (2023)`, `Gravity-perfused airway-on-a-chip optimized for quantitative BSL-3 studies of SARS-CoV-2 infection: barrier permeability, cytokine production, immunohistochemistry, and viral load assays`, and at least 3 true near-neighbor tools or papers from the Phase 1 literature review; every row states overlap, differentiation, and kill criteria.

items.description: Keep the prior-art gap file current through every core-feature decision
items.acceptance_criteria: After every major Phase 3 feature addition or pivot, `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` is updated with dated differentiation notes, evidence artifacts, and pivot decisions, and no section for the named watchlist papers remains blank by the end of the phase.

items.description: Delegate Phase 3 exploration and adversarial synthesis before locking the contribution
items.acceptance_criteria: A researcher exploration pass and a reviewer or falsifier synthesis pass are completed, and `results/phase3_decision_log.md` records the promoted idea, the retired idea, the remaining evidence obligations, and whether H1 remains champion or H2 is activated.

items.description: Execute analytic control experiments across multiple timestep settings
items.acceptance_criteria: The experiment suite runs circular orbit, ellipse, period recovery, escape velocity, and orbital element recovery scenarios across at least 3 timestep values each, stores machine-readable outputs, and summarizes results in `results/verification/analytic_controls.md`.

items.description: Measure invariant drift and timestep convergence on long-horizon scenarios
items.acceptance_criteria: Long-horizon experiments report energy drift, angular-momentum drift, center-of-mass drift, and timestep-halving convergence curves for 2-body, 3-body, and at least 1 small-N case, and thresholds from `results/benchmark_spec.md` are marked pass or fail.

items.description: Compare the simulator against trusted and literature-derived baselines
items.acceptance_criteria: Matched-scenario comparisons are run against REBOUND or an equivalent trusted reference plus at least 2 Phase 1 baselines, and `results/verification/benchmark_report.md` includes error tables, runtime tables, and a narrative explaining where the minimal simulator wins, ties, or loses relative to prior work.

items.description: Evaluate cross-runtime reproducibility and the close-encounter failure envelope
items.acceptance_criteria: The same scenario bundle is executed in at least 2 runtimes or numeric targets, and `results/verification/reproducibility_report.md` records tolerance envelopes, divergence cases, and at least 1 close-encounter stress test with explicit safe and unsafe operating regimes.

items.description: Delegate independent specialist verification and market-facing novelty checks
items.acceptance_criteria: A researcher execution pass plus independent novelty_checker, citation_auditor, and benchmark_auditor audits are completed; `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`, and `results/verification/verification_summary.md` all exist; and `results/verification/verification_summary.md` lists pass or fail decisions and required follow-ups from all specialist reviewers.

items.description: Write a claim-bounded analysis grounded in the measured evidence
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/analysis.md` states the final contribution as an audited deterministic minimal gravity reference kernel or a documented pivot, cites evidence from Phases 2 through 4, and explicitly lists non-claims about new integrators, large-N performance, or UI novelty.

items.description: Document failure modes, scope limits, and unresolved research questions
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/failure_envelope.md` describes close-encounter limits, unit and scale caveats, dimensionality limits, runtime-specific divergence, and open questions mapped back to H1, H2, H3, and the falsifier concerns.

items.description: Finalize citation completeness and prior-art linkage across all claims
items.acceptance_criteria: `sources.bib` and `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` receive a final update, every major claim in `results/analysis.md` cites at least 1 source from `sources.bib`, and `results/verification/citation_audit.md` reports no uncited named baseline or prior-art comparator.

items.description: Package reproducibility and benchmark documentation for the repo
items.acceptance_criteria: Repo-root `README.md` or `results/reproducibility.md` explains how to run the simulator, benchmark suite, and verification reports, and links to scenario definitions, output folders, and specialist artifacts under `results/verification/`.

items.description: Delegate final writing and red-team review before declaring the plan complete
items.acceptance_criteria: A writer drafting pass and an independent reviewer red-team pass are completed, and `results/final_review.md` lists at least 5 claim edits or confirmations, verifies alignment with `results/swarm/director_brief.md`, and confirms comparisons against literature reviewed in Phase 1.
